work.description: DCCXLVIII: complete Ubi primum conventionem four-clause brief, all four printed episcopal recipients, delegated process/notarial/witness powers, injunction/blessing and full datum LF52376–52381. Own date and marginal apparatus LF52263–52278 plus detached Monitum ad episcopos LF52387–52388 retained; isolated v LF52384 is page debris. XML leaf392 whole substantive body is L/R without wide joins; outer-right label LF52387 [1348,925,1454,940] is marginal, not displaced body. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
